Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

RiboPilot 0.1.1

Assemble

  • The Assemble details window aligns a sample’s assembly paths and shows the alignment in the sequence viewer, with differing columns marked.
  • New projects default to a maximum of 20 assembly paths and 20 contigs per path (was 10). Existing projects keep their settings.

RiboPilot 0.1.0

Before you upgrade

  • Make your existing projects again with new_project(). Projects made before this version do not record their database version and cannot be updated.
  • From this version on, a project records its database version. After a later upgrade, run backwards_compatibility() on each project instead of making it again. See “Upgrading RiboPilot” in the Installation guide.

Reference database

  • The rDNA BLAST panel is 2026.08.18.1. It leaves out six Canis aureus PREDICTED rRNA records (XR_013375787, 788, 790, 791, 794, and 795) whose sequences are flatfish contamination; they produced a false “PREDICTED: Canis” chimera flag on a flounder sample. Known-bad GenBank records are listed in dev/refdb/exclusions.csv and dropped at build time.
